cards.title: Sides of a right triangle
cards.text: The hypotenuse is the side opposite the right angle. The opposite side faces the selected acute angle. The adjacent side touches the selected acute angle and is not the hypotenuse.

cards.title: Sine, cosine and tangent in words
cards.text: Sine is the opposite side divided by the hypotenuse. Cosine is the adjacent side divided by the hypotenuse. Tangent is the opposite side divided by the adjacent side. These side names refer to the selected acute angle.

cards.title: Reciprocal trigonometric ratios
cards.text: Cosecant is the reciprocal of sine. Secant is the reciprocal of cosine. Cotangent is the reciprocal of tangent, wherever the corresponding ratios are defined.

cards.title: Arithmetic progressions and common difference
cards.text: In an arithmetic progression, each term after the first is formed by adding the same fixed amount. The common difference is the fixed change from a term to the next. The common difference may be positive, negative or zero.

cards.title: Meaning of a quadratic equation
cards.text: A quadratic equation has a nonzero coefficient of the squared term after like terms have been collected. Its highest remaining power of the variable is two.
